note: Armies instead of garrisons, played to the end: five switches on medium land maps with a day limit of 300 (every game is decided), 24 per config. Q = garrisons with legs (townHeroes); B = a second leader (secondArmy); T = a foreign town is worth what it yields on any day (townWorth); P = creatures the garrison has no slot for are bought by a hero in the gate (spareStock); N = holding a town of ours counts like taking one (townKeep). Design 2^(5-1), resolution V, N = -Q*B*T*P (the plain standard is one of the 16): main effects and all two-factor interactions are free of each other. Why: in d926 (384 games, 150 days) Q and B together scored 0.607 against 0.48 for either alone or neither; in d921 (48 games, 300 days) 13 of the 16 games undecided on day 150 were lost in the end - the standard wins 52 % of games played to the end, and wins must be counted to the end. Evaluate with arena/effects.py and arena/metrics.py: --factors '{"Q": {"townHeroes": 1}, "B": {"secondArmy": 1}, "T": {"townWorth": 1}, "P": {"spareStock": 1}, "N": {"townKeep": 1}}'
